pathBase: Paths beginning .build/ or native-macos/ are relative to project root; package verification preserves absolute artifact paths.

successfulAttempt.modelSavedUpdatedAtAvailability: private/unavailable; model.savedProjects updatedAt is the published acknowledgement

visualVerification.captureType: Own-process NSView/WK snapshots; not system screenshots of installed product

method.operationWindow: 12 seconds, operations wait for real UI/render acknowledgements
method.ordering: For each case: baseline/fixed in rounds 1 and 3; fixed/baseline in round 2
method.powerAssertion: Temporary caffeinate -diu, user confirmed Mac unlocked; no permanent setting change
method.scope: Native diagnostic process CPU and 50ms main-queue timer lateness. Excludes WebKit/GPU/WindowServer CPU; not FPS or energy.

normalProductStartup.scope: Normal product binary startup only; no automation of product UI or edits to personal data.
